tasks.subject: Task 1: Extract TextPipeline.run from AppDelegate inline prompt-assembly closure
Task 2: Add comma-feedback-loop regression test in TextPipelineTests
Task 3: Add 'speakfree process <wav>' headless subcommand emitting JSON
Task 4: Audio golden test harness with property assertions + 3-fixture seed manifest
Task 5: Fix WhisperEngine streaming-callback use-after-free (scout #2) — snapshot cb+trimmed before async; also fix [weak self] in onPartialResult AppDelegate closure capturing self strongly
Task 6: Serialize WhisperEngine load/transcribe/unload via engineQueue — use public+*Locked pattern to prevent re-entrancy deadlock; fix applicationWillTerminate to dispatch sync onto engineQueue
Task 7: Snapshot ALL config-derived state on main at finalizeRecording entry (config, recordingStyleMode, vocab, language) — not just self.config
Task 8: Confine isPressed to OSAllocatedUnfairLock<Bool> ONLY (drop DispatchQueue.main.sync option — deadlock risk)
Task 9: Add AX rangeValue nil-check + type-id guard before force-cast at AppDelegate:416 + TextInserter:28 (scout #10)
Task 10: Per-recording generation token to discard stale OCR — confine token + screenContextText to @MainActor; bump token on cancel/end too (scout #9)
Task 11: Salvage highest-confidence segment when no-speech filter would empty output — apply to BOTH batch and streaming paths; add salvage ceiling (prob < 0.9) (scout #13)
Task 12: AppleScript remote-desktop path — PID-targeting instead of process name; escape ANSI/NUL (Task 22 handles transcript sanitization); fix L355 paste path too (scout #12)
Task 13: File perms 0700/0600 + NSURLIsExcludedFromBackupKey on recordings dir (scout H5)
Task 14: Route SIGINT through NSApp.terminate — use sig_atomic_t flag (not OSAtomic, deprecated); NSApp.terminate must be called on main thread (scout #14)
Task 15: SparkleAppcastTests — use capture group for extraction; assert decoded byte count == 64 (Ed25519); no force-unwrap
Task 16: Full test run + adversarial Codex+Opus subagent review of wave-1 diff
Task 17: Bump Version.swift to 1.3.0; rebuild/sign/notarize; regenerate appcast; rerun SparkleAppcastTests
Task 18: End-to-end Sparkle update verification on an old-version install
Task 19: Commit appcast; push branch; gh release create v1.3.0 + DMG; merge to main + push; poll live appcast
Task 20: Dogfood hand-off; capture findings; gate Wave 2 plan on Michael's greenlight
Task 21: Secure Input guard — re-enable CGEventTap on kCGEventTapDisabled* + check IsSecureEventInputEnabled() before insertion
Task 22: Strip ANSI escape codes and NUL bytes from transcript before keystroke insertion (preserve \n, \r, \t)
Task 23: Fix CGEventKeyboardSetUnicodeString 20-char silent truncation — chunk into ≤20 Unicode scalar segments
Task 24: Fix latency log — capture keyReleaseTime at handleRecordingStop (currently undercounts by 300ms; golden harness baseline is wrong)
Task 25: Set anti-hallucination decoding params: entropy_thold=2.8, logprob_thold=-1.25 (evidence: whisper.cpp #1724 #2286, arXiv 2505.12969)
Task 26: Strip Whisper non-speech bracket markers ([BLANK_AUDIO], (silence), etc.) in TextPipeline before insertion
Task 27: Add large-v3-turbo to model list + set as recommended default (4x faster than large-v3, near same accuracy, first-class in whisper.cpp 1.8.x)
